name: Agrosilvopastoral agroforestry (trees, crops and livestock)

soft_risks.risk: Livestock damage crops and compact soil, and tree area is taken out of cropping
soft_risks.mitigation: Separate grazing from the cropping season and fence the crop phase

soft_risks.risk: Three competing components draw on the same limited water
soft_risks.mitigation: Keep tree density low and stagger the livestock phase to the post-harvest period

mechanism: Trees, crops and animals occupy the same land in sequence, cycling nutrients through manure and litter while the canopy shelters both.
